pages.text: One cell not enough? The $(4)Energy Cell Serializer$(0) welds scattered cells into one mega-battery.$(br2)$(bold)Forming it:$(0)place the serializer in the centre and $(4)26 energy cells$(0) (any tier) around it to fill a 3×3×3 shell; connect a pipe to any shell cell to charge or drain the whole block.$(br2)$(bold)Total storage = 10 billion base + 26 × each cell's capacity$(0). With all Super cells that is 26 × 20 billion + 10 billion ≈ $(bold)521 billion$(0) AE.$(br2)(The creative-only "Infinite Cell" is a debug item — don't count on it in survival.)

The Serializer stacks "$(l:akaishi:energy_cell)Energy Cells$(/l)"; pair it with a "$(l:akaishi:generator)Generator$(/l)" or "$(l:akaishi:gen_matrix)Generator Matrix$(/l)" and wire it in with "$(l:akaishi:energy_pipe)Energy Pipes$(/l)".
